meta_data.base_class: Retrieve nutritional information for a given <food type in grocery> food item from a particular storeItems referred to - meaning edible products or beverages sold in stores, for which consumers may need to retrieve specific nutritional information such as protein, calories, or fat content.

tool_template.name: grocery_info.nutritional_info_for_<class>
tool_template.description: Retrieve nutritional information for a given <class> item from a particular store.

store.description: The particular store where the <class> item is available.

food.description: Name of <class> item for which information is needed.

brand_name.description: The brand name of the <class> item to retrieve.

include_health_labels.description: Indicates whether to include health-related certifications for the <class> item.

include_nutritional_summary.description: Specifies whether to include a summarized overview of the <class> item's nutritional profile instead of only individual nutrient values.

include_comparison_to_standard.description: If true, includes a comparison of the given <class> item's nutritional values against standard dietary reference values.
